internal.title: Incident Resolved: Cart Service High Error Rate Due to Flag-Induced Failures
internal.body:
At 12:19 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the cart service. Diagnosis identified a recent flag change ('cartFailure') causing Valkey connection failures, leading to a 25% error rate. The flag was disabled at 12:39 UTC after approval, resulting in immediate recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels. Checkout service latency was also elevated but secondary to the primary fault. The incident is resolved.

Timeline:
- 12:19: Alert received for cart service error rate spike.
- 12:39: Diagnosis confirmed flag-induced errors; flag disabled.
- 12:39: Recovery verified with normalized error rates.

Action items include reviewing flag deployment processes to prevent similar incidents.

external.title: Some cart operations experienced errors; issue resolved
external.body: Between 12:19 and 12:39 UTC, some customers experienced errors when using the cart service. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
